rationale: Compiled non-portable profiles prefer psps, ppps, dsss, dpss, dsps, ddss, dsds, dpps and dspp quartet-parallel Rys-K when their target resources support the schedule; portable and unsupported profiles retain incumbent recurrence with the independently selected work/fill schedule. An explicit exact-tuned manifest override replaces the shared class set, including an empty opt-out; absent overrides and compatible/non-tuned profiles use the shared default. Overrides never transfer across compatibility and unsupported explicit classes are rejected. Historical performance evidence was collected on sm_120 and does not imply equal gains elsewhere. Three-root classes use one-word 64-bit component masks and bounded local contraction, with generic scatter beyond its private footprint. Construction freezes selection and coverage filters cannot broaden preference. Lowering incumbent disables task preference; also select task fill to roll back both promotions. A separately identified joint campaign qualifies task Work companions with independent matrices/sanitizers, complete cold E+F mean/median gains against both standalone policies and retained actual Fock counts. Historical separate promotions and rejected cohorts remain independently labeled rather than relabeled as joint qualification.
revisit_condition: Changes to mathematical coverage, queue ownership or parallel granularity require renewed source-identified numerical, sanitizer and work-count qualification. A new compiled architecture requires a target-specific compile/resource smoke test and representative endpoint timing before performance claims, not wholesale duplication of scientific reference tests. Keep historical measurements and valid negative cohorts distinct.
